title: hectorcao/lp2106791-noble → ubuntu/noble-devel
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index e9441d9..b9ddfa4 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,21 @@
+libvirt (10.0.0-2ubuntu8.12) noble; urgency=medium
+
+  * Enable MSR kernel module load (LP: #2106791)
+    In recent CPUs, some CPU features detection is done by reading
+    Model Specific Registers (MSR). To do that, libvirt needs the
+    msr kernel module to be loaded.
+     - d/p/d/x86-install-modules-load.d-file-to-load-msr-module.patch
+     - d/rules : install msr.conf file for libvirt-daemon-system only
+       for affected arches (x86)
+     - d/libvirt-daemon-system.postinst : trigger the module load
+
+    The conf file is added to libvirt-daemon-system instead of libvirt-common
+    in later releases. libvirt-common already breaks/replaces
+    libvirt-daemon-system and therefore no further changes to allow upgrades
+    are needed.
+
+ -- Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>  Wed, 04 Feb 2026 09:56:00 +0100
+
 libvirt (10.0.0-2ubuntu8.11) noble-security; urgency=medium
 
   * SECURITY UPDATE: memory consumption DoS via XML parsing
diff --git a/debian/libvirt-daemon-system.postinst b/debian/libvirt-daemon-system.postinst
index 66292cb..8a149c9 100644
--- a/debian/libvirt-daemon-system.postinst
+++ b/debian/libvirt-daemon-system.postinst
@@ -268,6 +268,16 @@ case "$1" in
         if [ -z $2 ]; then
             maybe_set_autostart
         fi
+
+        # Load the msr module right away to properly detect CPU features from
+        # Model Specific Registers.
+        # At boot, the module is loaded automatically by modules-load.
+        MSR_MODULES_LOAD_FILE="/etc/modules-load.d/libvirt-msr.conf"
+        if [ -z "${DPKG_ROOT}" ] && [ -d /run/systemd/system ]; then
+            if [ -x /usr/lib/systemd/systemd-modules-load ]; then
+                /usr/lib/systemd/systemd-modules-load ${MSR_MODULES_LOAD_FILE} || true
+            fi
+        fi
     ;;
 
     abort-upgrade|abort-remove|abort-deconfigure)

 debian/apparmor_profiles_local_include.patch

+ubuntu/x86-install-modules-load.d-file-to-load-msr-module.patch
 ubuntu/Allow-libvirt-group-to-access-the-socket.patch
 ubuntu/daemon-augeas-fix-expected.patch
 ubuntu/ubuntu_machine_type.patch
diff --git a/debian/patches/ubuntu/x86-install-modules-load.d-file-to-load-msr-module.patch b/debian/patches/ubuntu/x86-install-modules-load.d-file-to-load-msr-module.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1d6e71f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/ubuntu/x86-install-modules-load.d-file-to-load-msr-module.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,148 @@
+Description: x86: install modules-load.d file to load msr module
+On recent Intel CPUs, some of the CPU features (e.g.
+vmx-* sub-features) are listed and controlled via the
+MSRs (Model Specific Registers) instead of the traditional
+CPUID instruction method.
+
+To be able to read the MSR's values, the kernel module msr
+has to be loaded and the values can be read via /dev/cpu/*/msr.
+
+This commit introduces following changes:
+
+- install modules-load.d file for msr for x86.
+  by default, this option is enabled but user can disable it
+  via a build option:
+    meson ... -Dmsr_module_load=false ... build
+
+- modify virt-host-validate to check of /dev/cpu/*/msr is
+  available.
+
+Author: Andrea Bolognani <abologna@redhat.com>
+Origin: backport, https://lists.libvirt.org/archives/list/devel@lists.libvirt.org/thread/5WYDTKXASM4Y7ZT4VW7ADXDVBRISK6VD/
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/libvirt/+bug/2106791
+Last-Update: 2026-02-04
+
+---
+ libvirt.spec.in                        |  2 ++
+ meson.build                            | 22 ++++++++++++++++++++++
+ meson_options.txt                      |  1 +
+ src/util/libvirt-msr.modules-load.conf |  1 +
+ src/util/meson.build                   |  8 ++++++++
+ tools/virt-host-validate-qemu.c        |  7 +++++++
+ 6 files changed, 41 insertions(+)
+ create mode 100644 src/util/libvirt-msr.modules-load.conf
+
+diff --git a/libvirt.spec.in b/libvirt.spec.in
+index 8413e3c19a..5cc1238bd3 100644
+--- a/libvirt.spec.in
++++ b/libvirt.spec.in
+@@ -1356,6 +1356,7 @@ export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(stat --printf='%Y' %{_specdir}/libvirt.spec)
+            -Dqemu_datadir=%{qemu_datadir} \
+            -Dtls_priority=%{tls_priority} \
+            %{?enable_werror} \
++           -Dmsr_module_load=disabled \
+            -Dexpensive_tests=enabled \
+            -Dinit_script=systemd \
+            -Ddocs=enabled \
+@@ -1438,6 +1439,7 @@ export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(stat --printf='%Y' %{_specdir}/libvirt.spec)
+   -Dstorage_vstorage=disabled \
+   -Dstorage_zfs=disabled \
+   -Dsysctl_config=disabled \
++  -Dmsr_module_load=disabled \
+   -Dtests=disabled \
+   -Dudev=disabled \
+   -Dwireshark_dissector=disabled \
+diff --git a/meson.build b/meson.build
+index 1e5e1d7954..d6232104e4 100644
+--- a/meson.build
++++ b/meson.build
+@@ -2061,6 +2061,27 @@ if get_option('test_coverage')
+   ]
+ endif
+ 
++if not get_option('msr_module_load').disabled()
++  # msr module load makes sense only for linux and x86 CPUs
++  msr_module_load = true
++  if host_machine.system() != 'linux'
++    if get_option('msr_module_load').enabled()
++      error('msr module loading can be enabled on Linux only')
++    else
++      msr_module_load = false
++    endif
++  endif
++  if host_machine.cpu_family() not in [ 'x86', 'x86_64' ]
++    if get_option('msr_module_load').enabled()
++      error('msr module loading can be enabled on x86 only')
++    else
++      msr_module_load = false
++    endif
++  endif
++  if msr_module_load
++    conf.set('WITH_MSR_MODULE_LOAD', 1)
++  endif
++endif
+ 
+ # Various definitions
+ 
+@@ -2323,6 +2344,7 @@ misc_summary = {
+   'virt-login-shell': conf.has('WITH_LOGIN_SHELL'),
+   'virt-host-validate': conf.has('WITH_HOST_VALIDATE'),
+   'TLS priority': conf.get_unquoted('TLS_PRIORITY'),
++  'msr module load': conf.has('WITH_MSR_MODULE_LOAD'),
+ }
+ summary(misc_summary, section: 'Miscellaneous', bool_yn: true, list_sep: ' ')
+ 
+diff --git a/meson_options.txt b/meson_options.txt
+index 182e28b3d1..44313a46a0 100644
+--- a/meson_options.txt
++++ b/meson_options.txt
+@@ -109,3 +109,4 @@ option('nbdkit_config_default', type: 'feature', value: 'auto', description: 'Wh
+ option('pm_utils', type: 'feature', value: 'auto', description: 'use pm-utils for power management')
+ option('sysctl_config', type: 'feature', value: 'auto', description: 'Whether to install sysctl configs')
+ option('tls_priority', type: 'string', value: 'NORMAL', description: 'set the default TLS session priority string')
++option('msr_module_load', type: 'feature', value: 'auto', description: 'Install modules-load.d file for msr module')
+diff --git a/src/util/libvirt-msr.modules-load.conf b/src/util/libvirt-msr.modules-load.conf
+new file mode 100644
+index 0000000000..3e5ee7fa15
+--- /dev/null
++++ b/src/util/libvirt-msr.modules-load.conf
+@@ -0,0 +1 @@
++msr
+diff --git a/src/util/meson.build b/src/util/meson.build
+index c2175f1098..16e4fb68d4 100644
+--- a/src/util/meson.build
++++ b/src/util/meson.build
+@@ -223,4 +223,12 @@ if conf.has('WITH_LIBVIRTD')
+   }
+ endif
+ 
++if conf.has('WITH_MSR_MODULE_LOAD')
++  install_data(
++    'libvirt-msr.modules-load.conf',
++    install_dir: sysconfdir / 'modules-load.d',
++    rename: 'libvirt-msr.conf',
++  )
++endif
++
+ util_inc_dir = include_directories('.')
+diff --git a/tools/virt-host-validate-qemu.c b/tools/virt-host-validate-qemu.c
+index 3eeee516d3..b268dfe491 100644
+--- a/tools/virt-host-validate-qemu.c
++++ b/tools/virt-host-validate-qemu.c
+@@ -95,6 +95,13 @@ int virHostValidateQEMU(void)
+             virHostMsgPass();
+     }
+ 
++    if (ARCH_IS_X86(arch)) {
++        if (virHostValidateDeviceExists("QEMU", "/dev/cpu/0/msr",
++                                        VIR_HOST_VALIDATE_WARN,
++                                        _("Load the 'msr' module for better x86 CPU features detection")) < 0)
++            ret = -1;
++    }
++
+     if (virHostValidateDeviceExists("QEMU", "/dev/vhost-net",
+                                     VIR_HOST_VALIDATE_WARN,
+                                     _("Load the 'vhost_net' module to improve performance of virtio networking")) < 0)
+-- 
+2.34.1
+
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index fadb91a..632bf4c 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ ARCHES_QEMU = amd64 arm64 armel armhf i386 mips64el mipsel powerpc ppc64 ppc64el
 ARCHES_LXC  = alpha amd64 arm64 armel armhf hppa i386 m68k mips64el mipsel powerpc ppc64 ppc64el riscv64 s390x sh4 sparc64 x32
 ARCHES_XEN  = amd64 arm64 armhf
 ARCHES_VBOX = amd64 i386

@@ -390,6 +391,9 @@ ifneq (,$(filter $(DEB_HOST_ARCH), $(ARCHES_XEN)))
 	dh_install -p libvirt-daemon-system etc/libvirt/libxl-lockd.conf
 	dh_install -p libvirt-daemon-system etc/libvirt/libxl-sanlock.conf
 endif
+ifneq (,$(filter $(DEB_HOST_ARCH), $(ARCHES_MSR)))
+	dh_install -p libvirt-daemon-system etc/modules-load.d/libvirt-msr.conf
+endif
 
 ifeq ($(DEB_HOST_ARCH_OS), linux)
